hangzhou-1.bio: Hangzhou's freshwater lake, ringed by causeways, islands, pagodas and temples, with a free lakeside promenade.
hangzhou-1.ticket_note: Official West Lake Scenic Area site (hzwestlake.gov.cn) did not load from this network (fetch failed); not verified, so no link. Check in a browser.
hangzhou-1.notes: Lake circuit free since 2002 per Hangzhou Daily; Lingyin Temple and some paid sights nearby are separate. Lake area/causeways/islands from Wikipedia.

anji-6.bio: A high-mountain resort above Anji with a snow-season ski area, cliff swings and a grassland plateau at 1,168 m.
anji-6.ticket_note: No official website found (Ctrip results only); likely WeChat-only. Unverified.
anji-6.notes: 174 is Ctrip's 'from' price for the scenic-area gate ticket (a 2024 reseller listed adult 180); ski lift/rental prices NOT found (unverified) and some play areas pause in snow season. Elevation 1,168 m and 'closest natural-snow ski area to Hangzhou' from Ctrip/draft; the 'closest' claim is dropped from the bio.

youbu-ancient-town.bio: A river-port town in Lanxi with old streets, a 500 m breakfast lane and lantern and lion-dance traditions.
youbu-ancient-town.ticket_note: No official site; town is open access, run by the township.
youbu-ancient-town.notes: Ctrip guide text says the town is free all day and parking is free (weak source). The lantern and lion-dance claim is from the draft and is not confirmed in the fetched source; check or reword before use.

songlan-mountain-beach.bio: A long sand-and-rock coast on Xiangshan's east shore, with beaches, headlands and a seaside walking path.
songlan-mountain-beach.ticket_note: No official site found; resort area managed locally (Xiangshan), WeChat only. Unverified.
songlan-mountain-beach.notes: Ctrip lists the 4A resort as free, open all day (weak). Car park charges (10 yuan/vehicle) are not the price. Beach vs resort extent unverified.

dachen-islands.bio: An island group off Taizhou reached by ferry, with a clifftop walkway, wartime sites and seafood villages.
dachen-islands.ticket_note: No official site found; booking is via a WeChat account (Dachen Tourism / Taizhou ticketing). Unverified.
dachen-islands.notes: Islands themselves have no entry fee per Ctrip travellers (weak); Jiawu Rock cliff walkway charges separately (about 48 to 60 CNY, sources disagree) and is not the island price. Ferry from Jiaojiang about 80 to 130 CNY is transport, not the cost. Dachen is administered by Jiaojiang District, Taizhou. The islands are 'one spot' covering Shang and Xia Dachen; worth a 'needs: booking' check for the ferry in peak season (daily cap about 2000 per a guide), unverified.

yandang-mountains-2.bio: One of Yandang's three classic sights, with sheer cliffs and a cliff-side walkway above the Lingyan valley.
yandang-mountains-2.ticket_note: Official Yandang Scenic Area site (title 雁荡山, hotline 0577-6217-8888, lists Lingyan Scenic Area). Online ticket link goes to wap.lotsmall.cn which is BLOCKED to scripts: check prices in a real browser. Also en.wzyds.com.
yandang-mountains-2.notes: 50 CNY is a 2024 reseller price for the standalone Lingyan ticket (weak); official page does not show it. Combo (Lingfeng+Lingyan+Dalongqiu) about 170 CNY. 'Wiki' broader article 'Yandang Mountains' not used. Cliff-side walkway (Wo Yun plank road) is named on the official hours notice; 'three classic sights' (灵峰、灵岩、大龙湫) per official site.

hangzhou-12.bio: Song-dynasty theme park in Hangzhou with period streets and a daily live show retelling local history.
hangzhou-12.ticket_note: Operator Songcheng Performance's site; its Hangzhou park page names 杭州宋城. Page shows no price.

sources.cost: https://stock.10jqka.com.cn/20260617/c677540339.shtml (company-announcement report: walk-up price from 320 yuan; other guides say 260-290 online, 280 standard)

hangzhou-12.notes: Price is a walk-up combined ticket (park plus Songcheng Qianguqing show) and varies by day/channel; unverified on operator page. Old zh Wikipedia price (120) is outdated.
unverified: opening hours not recorded by rule

anji-7.bio: Zhejiang natural history museum branch in Anji with geology, dinosaur and ecology halls.
anji-7.ticket_note: Zhejiang Museum of Natural History site (title 浙江自然博物院); loads, covers the Anji branch via its booking service.

sources.cost: https://hznews.hangzhou.com.cn/chengshi/content/2018-12/29/content_7124124_2.htm (permanent exhibitions free, reserve online by ID)

anji-7.notes: Free/booking rule from 2018 opening report; temporary exhibitions may charge. Current rule unverified on official site.
unverified: opening hours not recorded by rule

zhuge-bagua-village.bio: Ming-Qing village near Lanxi laid out on the eight trigrams around a central pond, with ancestral halls to visit.
zhuge-bagua-village.ticket_note: No official site found; scenic area is sold via Ctrip/Meituan and WeChat only.
zhuge-bagua-village.notes: Ctrip 'from' price, weak; 6 small paid sights inside need extra tickets (Ctrip). Verify on site.
unverified: opening hours not recorded by rule

xikou-2.bio: Buddhist mountain near Xikou with Xuedou Temple and its Maitreya statue.
xikou-2.ticket_note: No official site found; scenic area run under Xikou scenic area, sold via Ctrip/WeChat.

sources.cost: https://gs.ctrip.com/html5/you/sight/1020/107387.html (Ctrip 'from 150', one traveller says ticket plus in-area transport 150)

xikou-2.notes: Price weak and may include in-area shuttle; Chiang ancestral home combo is ~240. Bio mentions of temple/statue from zh Wikipedia and Ctrip.
unverified: opening hours not recorded by rule

dalu-island.bio: Forested island off Yuhuan reached by ferry, with sea-eroded rocks, carved cliffs and a small resort.
dalu-island.ticket_note: No official site found. Island is 大鹿岛 (Dalu Island), Yuhuan; the input zh '大陆岛' looks wrong.

sources.cost: https://www.dahepiao.com/lvyounews1/20240529467245.html (adult 45 yuan; ferry about 64 round trip, not included)

dalu-island.notes: Fix zh name to 大鹿岛. Ferry from Zhantai pier; ferries suspended in typhoons. Price from ticket agent, weak.
unverified: opening hours not recorded by rule

yandang-mountains-3.bio: Scenic area in the Yandang Mountains whose 197 m waterfall is among China's tallest single-drop falls.
yandang-mountains-3.ticket_note: No official site found; Yandang Mountains scenic area ticketing is via WeChat/agents.
yandang-mountains-3.notes: Entry covers Dalongchu sub-area; Yandang combined ticket may differ. Scenic area name Dalongchu (大龙湫); zh in input is generic 雁荡山.
unverified: opening hours not recorded by rule

hangzhou-5.bio: Wetland park of reed marshes, ponds and canals west of Hangzhou, explored on foot or by traditional boat.
hangzhou-5.ticket_note: xixiwetland.com is a parked domain, not the park's site; no verified official site found
hangzhou-5.notes: 80 CNY adult from zh.wikipedia ticket table marked outdated; one ticket enters east and west zones once each that day. Boat fare extra. Verify current price.

wuzhen-2.bio: The Eastern Quarter of Wuzhen water town, with canals, stone bridges, old workshops and the Mao Dun former residence.
wuzhen-2.ticket_note: homepage title reads Wuzhen tourism official website; loads over http only (https fails from script); deep ticket page not checked
wuzhen-2.notes: 110 CNY from third-party ticket sites, not the operator page; East+West combined 190. Verify. Wikipedia article for Wuzhen Eastern Quarter does not exist.

ningbo-10.bio: Walled former county town of Jiangbei with Tang-era origins, old lanes, a Confucian temple and the county yamen.
ningbo-10.ticket_note: no single official site found; cicheng.com.cn did not show a place title
ningbo-10.notes: Town streets free per Ctrip/Qunar travel notes (weak); some sights inside (yamen, Confucian temple) charge, e.g. 75 CNY four-site combo. Wikipedia 'Cicheng' is the town article, so the 'Tang-era origins' claim is from it (8th century); no wiki field needed.

dafo-temple-xinchang.bio: Temple in Xinchang town built around a giant Buddha carved into the cliff, known as the first rock-cut Buddha of Jiangnan.
dafo-temple-xinchang.notes: Ctrip lists 80 CNY, ticket reseller lists from 68; both weak. 'Jiangnan first rock-cut Buddha' is from the Ctrip page title only (weak). Wikipedia dab page lists 'Dafo Temple (Xinchang)' but that article was not read, so wiki is null; check it exists.

furong-ancient-village.bio: Ancient village in Yongjia County on the Nanxi River, with old lanes and halls, on a shared ticket with two nearby villages.
furong-ancient-village.notes: 18 CNY from ticket reseller (2024); combined with Lishui Old Street and Cangpo 36 CNY. Bio details beyond location and ticket are unverified (no source read): confirm before use. No English Wikipedia article.

mount-putuo-4.bio: Temple near the summit of Foding Mountain on Mount Putuo, reached by cable car or about 45 minutes on foot.
mount-putuo-4.notes: 5 CNY incense-flower ticket for the three main temples per a blog; the Mount Putuo scenic area gate fee (160 CNY, blog) is a separate fee, and cable car 70 return, neither is this cost. Verify whether the scenic-area fee should be attached by park rule. Wikipedia 'Huiji Temple' is a disambiguation page, wiki null.

hangzhou-6.bio: Willow-lined causeway across West Lake, built by the poet Su Shi and walked or cycled between lake and hills.
hangzhou-6.ticket_note: Public causeway on a free lake shore; no operator site.
hangzhou-6.notes: Free/open from general knowledge of West Lake's free shoreline, no price page fetched; Su Shi attribution not re-verified from a fetched page. English wiki 'Su Causeway' redirects to West Lake, so wiki should be null.

fangyan-scenic-area.bio: Danxia red-rock scenic area in Yongkang with a half-hour climb to the Hu Gong temple on the summit.
fangyan-scenic-area.ticket_note: No official site found by search (only ticket resellers).
fangyan-scenic-area.notes: Ctrip 65 (from 60), reseller 63; one ticket covers Fangyan and Nanyan, sub-areas (Wufeng, Shiguliao) extra. 4A and Danxia status from zh.wikipedia disambiguation page (national scenic area); Hu Gong climb ~30 min from search summary. Hours not recorded.

ningbo-16.bio: Fortified hill at the mouth of the Yong River in Zhenhai, with Ming-era Weiyuan fort and coastal-defence relics.
ningbo-16.notes: PRICE UNVERIFIED: only a 2011 travelogue (80, 50 at New Year); current price not found. National 4A, key heritage coastal-defence ruins from zh.wikipedia; Weiyuan fort Ming Jiajing 39 from search summary.

shaoxing-2.bio: Song-dynasty garden in Shaoxing where the poet Lu You wrote of his lost love Tang Wan, with ponds and pavilions.
shaoxing-2.notes: PRICE UNVERIFIED: search found only combo tickets (145 four-site, 198 with Lu Xun house) and a Ctrip post claiming free entry; I could not confirm a single adult price, 40 is my uncertain figure and should be rechecked. Garden is a provincial heritage unit, Lu You story per zh.wikipedia; Tang Wan name not in fetched text. Ctrip hours showed evening opening/night show, ignored.

jiangxin-island.bio: Islet in the Ou River at Wenzhou with twin pagodas, Jiangxin Temple and a former British consulate, reached by ferry.
jiangxin-island.ticket_note: Official presence is the scenic-area management office; no site found.
jiangxin-island.notes: ENTRY NAME ISSUE: evidence bundle's Wikipedia excerpt is the Nanjing Jiangxin Island (江心洲); this spot is Wenzhou's 江心屿 (zh name field wrong), coordinates are the Wenzhou islet. English article 'Jiangxinyu' is the right one. 30 CNY adult includes round-trip ferry (2024 reseller article, weak); Ctrip lists it free. 4A scenic area per zh.wikipedia.

mount-putuo-5.bio: Highest hill on Putuo island, climbed by stone steps or cable car to Huiji Temple and views over the sea.
mount-putuo-5.notes: 140 (Dec-Jan) to 160 (Feb-Nov) is the Mount Putuo island gate fee, not a Foding fee; cable car about 70 return not counted. No China scenic-area pass exists in parkPasses.ts; decide whether to price spots inside Putuo or treat as covered by the island gate (shard 8 did not count it). Huiji temple at summit, 1080 steps per one travelogue (unverified).

hangzhou-9.bio: West Lake's only natural island, with Zhongshan Park, a former imperial palace site, and plum blossom gardens.
hangzhou-9.ticket_note: No single steward; part of the open West Lake scenic area.
hangzhou-9.notes: Free: the island and lake shore are open; no gate fee found for Gushan itself (individual sites on it, e.g. museums, were not checked). Visit time is an estimate.

hengdian-world-studios.bio: One of the world's largest outdoor film studios, with replica palaces and streets from Chinese period dramas.
hengdian-world-studios.ticket_note: Official site loaded; title is 横店影视城官方网站 (Hengdian World Studios official site).
hengdian-world-studios.notes: Weak price: official site shows only an all-zone combo from CNY 799; single-zone CNY 180-190 (Qin Palace 190, Guangzhou Street 190, Trip.com 180) comes from third-party sites. Tickets are sold per zone and zones are far apart. Visit hours estimate.

ningbo-2.bio: Ningbo's old riverside port quarter on the Yong River, with 54 listed sites including a Catholic cathedral.
ningbo-2.notes: Open waterfront area; free. Individual museums inside may charge (not checked). Visit time is an estimate.

shaoxing-7.bio: A Song-dynasty stone arch bridge in Shaoxing, named for its resemblance to the character for eight.
shaoxing-7.notes: Free and open: a street bridge on a canal (no gate fee found in sources; unverified by an official page).

master-and-apprentice-bridges.bio: Two covered timber bridges in Sixi village, Taishun, about 200 metres apart and known as the sister bridges.
master-and-apprentice-bridges.ticket_note: Village bridges; no official operator site found.
master-and-apprentice-bridges.notes: Chinese name 泗溪姐妹桥 (Xidong and Beijian bridges; the English name Master and Apprentice is not found in sources). Ctrip lists Beijian Bridge as open all day with no ticket price: free is weak/unverified. Beijian Bridge built 1674 per Ctrip.

moxin-mountain.bio: Daishan island's high point, with the Ciyun Jile temple, tea terraces and sea views.
moxin-mountain.notes: Weak: Ctrip shows 'from CNY 20', one review says that was a half-price day, another says free; full price unverified. Sources disagree whether Moxin or Yueping Gang is the island's high point (257.1 m); bio avoids the claim of 'highest'.

qiandao-lake.bio: Man-made lake in Chun'an with over a thousand islands, explored by boat from the lakeside piers.
qiandao-lake.ticket_note: No official website found; tickets sold via WeChat mini-programs (reported as 玩转千岛湖). Not verified.
qiandao-lake.notes: Price weak: Ctrip shows from 45.5 (south-east lake zone) to 195 (central lake combo with boat); varies by zone/season. Wikipedia: 1,078 islands over 2,500 sq m, reservoir 1959 (en summary). Unverified: any official fee.

jinhua-3.bio: Wooded limestone mountain north of Jinhua city, with a cave cluster, temples and walking paths.
jinhua-3.notes: zh Wikipedia: Jinhua Mountain (also Beishan), highest peak Dapanjian 1311 m, 50+ caves in karst belt Shuanglong cave to Lanxi. The 5A Shuanglong scenic area (separate ticket, Ctrip) is the paid part; entry fee for this spot UNVERIFIED, free/open is a placeholder. Bio's 'temples/paths' from draft, not independently sourced.

ningbo-7.bio: Crescent-shaped lake in central Ningbo, dug in the Tang era, with ten islets, bridges and old mansions.
ningbo-7.ticket_note: Municipal park, no official site found
ningbo-7.notes: Ctrip: free; zh Wikipedia: dug in Tang, ten islets shaped in Song, 0.2 sq km. Park gates have closing hours so costBasis could be entry (No Entry Fee) if the owner prefers. Rowing boats cost extra.

shaoxing-8.bio: Historic lanes in Shaoxing's old town around the Wang Xizhi residence, Jiezhu Temple and the Ink Pond.
shaoxing-8.ticket_note: Historic district, no single steward site found
shaoxing-8.notes: zh Wikipedia: district also called Shusheng Guli, holds Wang Xizhi's former residence (Jiezhu Temple, Ink Pond), Ti Shan Bridge. Street itself assumed free; individual sites (Jishan Academy 4 CNY per undated Ctrip travelogue) may charge: unverified.

south-yandang-mountain.bio: Rocky scenic mountain area in Pingyang County, Wenzhou, known for its cliffs, caves, temples and a cable car.
south-yandang-mountain.notes: PRICE UNVERIFIED: Ctrip page has conflicting text (mixes Beiyandang description) and shows status temporarily closed, reopening TBD. Cable car 25 one-way/40 return seen only in non-official travelogue. Consider holding. Is in Pingyang County, Wenzhou.

shenjiamen-fishing-port.bio: Working harbour on Zhoushan's Putuo district waterfront, lined with seafood restaurants and evening stalls.
shenjiamen-fishing-port.notes: Ctrip: free, no ticket. zh Wikipedia: national central fishing port. Night stalls (Binggang Road) are a Ctrip/news claim, location has moved (Bansheng Dong pier to East Port): bio kept general.

tianmu-mountain.bio: Nature reserve in Lin'an with giant trees and forest walking trails, reached by shuttle bus from the gate.
tianmu-mountain.ticket_note: No official site found; reserve bureau site unverified. Phone 0571-63857361 (third-party listing).
tianmu-mountain.notes: Third-party 2025 prices: 110 (half-day session) to 135 (all-day); Ctrip ~136. Whether shuttle bus is included unverified. wiki field: English article title equals name, so null in app if identical.

liudong-mountain.bio: Karst scenic area near Lanxi with limestone caves and an underground river explored by boat.
liudong-mountain.notes: Price is for the Underground River (地下长河) area from Ctrip/Qunar listings; not operator-confirmed. No English Wikipedia article (zh also missing).

shanglin-lake-yue-kilns.bio: Cluster of Tang-to-Song kiln sites beside Shanglin Lake in Cixi where Yue celadon was fired.
shanglin-lake-yue-kilns.notes: COST UNVERIFIED: no source states a fee for the kiln sites or the Yue Kiln Museum / celadon park. Needs a check. English article title equals name.

wuxie-scenic-area.bio: Scenic area near Zhuji with a five-tier waterfall, forested hills and a lake crossed by boat.
wuxie-scenic-area.notes: Ctrip list 70, from 60; third-party says 60 includes return boat ticket. National scenic area, AAAA, 9.45 km2 per zh Wikipedia. No English article.

wuma-street.bio: Pedestrian shopping street in old Wenzhou, about 424 m long, and the city's traditional commercial centre.
wuma-street.notes: Pedestrian street since 1985 per zh Wikipedia; 'food stalls' is loosely supported (shops confirmed) - rewrite to 'shops' if strict. No English article.

wushitang-beach.bio: Black-pebble shore on Zhujiajian island in Putuo, known for its smooth dark cobblestones.
wushitang-beach.notes: COST UNVERIFIED: Ctrip lists it inside the Wushitang scenic area, open all year; no clear fee found (one jumbled listing shows 20 or 90). Needs a check.

anji-5.bio: A village in Anji known for the 'two mountains' idea, with bamboo crafts, a cultural hall and stream walks.
anji-5.ticket_note: No official site found; village is open access, some attractions inside charge separately.
anji-5.notes: Free access from Ctrip visitor comments (weak); paid extras inside (shuttle 30 CNY, some fenced sights) are not the cost. 4A status per search summary, unverified. Draft bio claims Hidden-Dragon Waterfall and UN Tourism award not independently checked.

luzhai-residence.bio: A large Ming and Qing residential complex of the Lu family in Dongyang, with halls, lanes and carved timberwork to walk through.
luzhai-residence.notes: 58 CNY is Ctrip's 'from' price (weak); bio details (Lu family, carved timberwork) not source-checked beyond draft; unverified.

shipu.bio: A fishing-harbour old town on Xiangshan's coast, with stone lanes, old houses and a working seafood port.
shipu.notes: Ctrip lists the Shipu Fishing Port Ancient Town ticket at 60 CNY with 'from' 50 (weak, conflicting pages); older town is 600+ years per Ctrip. Pin is the town; ticket applies to the ancient-town scenic area. Verify in browser.

baima-ao-beach.bio: A 300 m golden sand beach at Baima Ao village on Yuhuan's Ganjiang coast, with fine quartz sand and sea views.
baima-ao-beach.notes: UNVERIFIED cost: maigoo lists 3A scenic area open all day, ~1 hr visit; no price found. Ctrip snippet 50 CNY not clearly tied to this beach. Needs owner decision; do not add until cost known.

wuyanling-national-nature-reserve.bio: A forested mountain reserve in Taishun County rising to 1,611 m at Baiyun Peak, with walking trails through old woodland.
wuyanling-national-nature-reserve.ticket_note: Old site cited by Wikipedia returned 403 captcha; check in a real browser.
wuyanling-national-nature-reserve.notes: 60 CNY adult from a Ctrip travelogue title (weak, unverified); Ctrip says 4A. Trails not source-checked; 'walking trails' is generic.

hangzhou-13.bio: Neolithic walled city of the Liangzhu culture in Hangzhou, a World Heritage site toured by shuttle.
hangzhou-13.ticket_note: Booking is via the 良渚古城遗址公园 WeChat account; no official web site found (liangzhu.cn unreachable).
hangzhou-13.notes: 80 CNY = 60 entry + 20 shuttle, from 2019 reports found by search, not an official current price; shuttle is the only way round the park. English Wikipedia title not confirmed (my guessed title 404'd); wiki null.

huzhou-2.bio: Former Yuan-dynasty garden of Zhao Mengfu in central Huzhou, with a lotus pond, pavilions and old trees.
huzhou-2.notes: Free per Ctrip visitor reviews only (weak); open 'open' vs staffed gate unverified.

heyang-ancient-village.bio: Old village in Jinyun with Ming and Qing ancestral halls and houses, noted for their wood and brick carving.
heyang-ancient-village.notes: 35 (Ctrip) to 40 (older Qunar trip report); no official price. Some ancestral halls may need ticket shown; combined ticket with Xiandu exists, price unknown. Age/dynasty and carving claims from Ctrip travelogue snippet, unverified against an official page.

xikou-4.bio: Eco-village near Fenghua with gardens and bonsai, rated a 5A scenic area together with Xikou.
xikou-4.ticket_note: Official village site loaded, title 中国•滕头村; names the place. Not deep-checked for ticket page.
xikou-4.notes: Ctrip lists 溪口-滕头 at about 210 CNY, but that may be a combined ticket; Tengtou-only adult price not found, so unverified. Bonsai garden and 5A (with Xikou, 2010) from Chinese Wikipedia; gardens claim loosely sourced.

dongji-islands.bio: Island group off Zhoushan, reached by boat from the mainland, with fishing villages, cliffs and sea views.
dongji-islands.ticket_note: No single official operator; ferries sold by several operators/WeChat.
dongji-islands.notes: Ctrip lists the island scenic area as free (weak); the return ferry from Zhoushan was about 140+ CNY in 2019 listings, but ferry is transport, not the cost. Zh Wikipedia: 45 islands, main ones Miaozihu, Qingbang, Huangxing, Dongfushan. English Wikipedia article not confirmed.

yandang-mountains-4.bio: Waterfall in the Yandang Mountains where the stream drops in several tiers down a gorge.
yandang-mountains-4.ticket_note: Part of Yandang Mountain scenic area; official site not verified.
yandang-mountains-4.notes: 20 CNY per Ctrip list (another trip report says about 15); may be separate from or included in the main Yandang ticket, unverified. 'Several tiers' follows the name 三折 (three folds): unverified against a source.

hangzhou-23.bio: A spring and park in southwest Hangzhou with wooded paths, bamboo groves and tea houses.
hangzhou-23.ticket_note: No official site found; not verified
hangzhou-23.notes: Adult 15 CNY (concession 7.5) from ticket-agent articles and Qunar, agree across sources; not official. Park-gate price, not a pass.

huzhou-4.bio: Tea mountain where Tang emperors' tribute tea was made, with the Tribute Tea Academy on its slope.
huzhou-4.notes: UNVERIFIED cost: no ticket price found for the mountain or the Datang Tribute Tea Academy (Tiger Head Rock, Changxing, built 770 CE). Needs a price source before applying; do not mark free. Lu Yu Classic of Tea link comes from the draft, not confirmed in sources fetched.

longquan-3.bio: A kiln-shaped museum in Longquan showing the history and craft of Longquan celadon.
longquan-3.notes: Ctrip lists it free, advance booking needed, but also flagged 'temporarily closed' (snapshot date unknown). Verify open status and booking before applying.

gengong-buddhist-kingdom.bio: A Buddhist-themed scenic park in Kaihua County, in the hills of Quzhou.
gengong-buddhist-kingdom.notes: Ctrip: list 180, from 118 (weak, discounted). Address Genbo Rd 1, Kaihua. Bio is generic because nothing about the attractions was verified from a source; rewrite if a source is found. Zhejiang location is Kaihua, not Kecheng.

linhai-ancient-city-wall.bio: Climb the old Taizhou city walls from Lanshengmen gate for views over Linhai's old town.
linhai-ancient-city-wall.ticket_note: Official presence is a mini-program; no site found
linhai-ancient-city-wall.notes: Ctrip: 60 listed, from 55, for the Taizhou Fu Cultural Tourism Area (walls). Ziyang Street is free. East Lake price unclear.

yuhai-tower.bio: A Qing-era scholar's library house in Rui'an, built in 1888, with rooms now used as exhibits.
yuhai-tower.notes: Free per a Qunar user comment only (weak). Built 1888 by Sun Yiyan; national key heritage site 1996; collection moved to Rui'an Museum 2013.

hangzhou-26.bio: Canal-side museum cluster in Hangzhou with galleries of crafts, knives and swords, fans and umbrellas.
hangzhou-26.ticket_note: zgdjss.com appeared in a search summary but did not load; unverified, not recorded
hangzhou-26.notes: Free general admission per a 2021 China Daily Zhejiang page; reconfirm. Cluster of four museums (crafts, knives/scissors/swords, fans, umbrellas) in the Gongchen Bridge canal area.

lake-tai.bio: China's third-largest freshwater lake, with about 90 islands, its southern shore forming the Zhejiang border at Huzhou.
lake-tai.ticket_note: no single steward; lakeside parks charge separately
lake-tai.notes: Wikipedia article title is 'Lake Tai' = name, so wiki null. Pin 31.0611,119.9807 is in open water, mostly Jiangsu side; coordinates left untouched per brief but a Huzhou shore access point would suit a visitor pin better. Fees of individual lakeside parks not researched.

shimen-cave-scenic-area.bio: Forest park on the Oujiang near Qingtian, with a 112 m waterfall, rock inscriptions and a shrine to Liu Ji.
shimen-cave-scenic-area.notes: CNY 60 from a 2019 Zhejiang tourism-bureau page, seen only via a search summary (page did not load for me); may have changed. Waterfall drop ~112.5 m, about 31 km NW of Qingtian town, per search summary of Ctrip. 'National heritage' status in the draft not verified.

jiangshan-3.bio: Ancestral village of the Jiangnan Mao clan in Jiangshan, with old halls and a reputed link to Mao Zedong's family.
jiangshan-3.notes: CNY 50 is a Ctrip starting price (weak); an older guide said 40. One of three parts of the Jianglang Mountain-Nianbadu scenic area; combined ticket not checked. Mao ancestry claim is from local sources, hence 'reputed'; 'old halls' is unverified detail.

shitang-fishing-village.bio: Wenling coastal fishing town of stacked stone houses, many now guesthouses, beside the Millennium Dawn viewing park.
shitang-fishing-village.notes: Free/open is unverified: Ctrip lists all-day access but no adult price was seen. The Millennium Dawn Park (first mainland sunrise of 2000) may charge separately; unconfirmed.

dongfu-mountain.bio: Sunrise lookout on Dongfu Island in the Dongji group, marking where mainland China's first dawn of 2000 was watched.
dongfu-mountain.notes: No entry fee found in travel guides; not authoritatively confirmed. Reached by inter-island boat from Shengjiamen/Miaozihu (about CNY 30, cash, per travel posts); boat fare is not the cost. Dawn claim comes from guides only.

hangzhou-28.bio: Late-Qing traditional Chinese medicine pharmacy on Dajing Lane, now a museum and working drugstore.
hangzhou-28.ticket_note: Old hqyt.com no longer loads (only an archived copy); no working official site or WeChat-free page found.
hangzhou-28.notes: Price CNY 15 is the lowest Qunar listing, unverified; may be a separate charge for the drugstore side.

moganshan-villa-cluster.bio: Early-20th-century villas built by foreign residents and officials among bamboo forest on Moganshan near Hangzhou.
moganshan-villa-cluster.ticket_note: Page title 莫干山官网; Wikipedia lists it as the official site. Page body is script-rendered, not read.
moganshan-villa-cluster.notes: Price CNY about 80 is the mountain scenic-area ticket from blog articles (range 70-85), not confirmed from the operator; villa cluster not priced separately in sources. Villa count (~150) from draft, unverified.

tongji-weir.bio: Weir and irrigation works at Bihu near Lishui, begun in the Liang dynasty and counted the world's earliest arch dam.
tongji-weir.ticket_note: No official visitor site found; national heritage site.
tongji-weir.notes: Entry fee not found; free/open is unverified. Wikipedia: Bihu town, Liandu District, Lishui; built Southern Liang, stone weir 1205, arch weir 275 m.

jiangshan-4.bio: Mountain pass on the Xianxia ancient road through Xianxialing, with four gates and about five km of stone-paved path.
jiangshan-4.notes: UNRESOLVED price: free entry was a promotion that ended 31 Mar 2026 (Quzhou); regular fee not found. Not stated as free.

taizhou-2.bio: Aquarium on Guangchang Middle Road beside the Taizhou citizens' square, with marine animal exhibits and shows.
taizhou-2.notes: CNY 150 adult (1.4 m+) from ticket platforms 2025; a 2019 provincial page said 120. Shows/exhibit details unverified.

dongji.bio: Island group off Zhoushan with fishing villages, Miaozihu and Qingbang islands, and the setting of the film Hou Hui Wu Qi.
dongji.notes: Island entry fee not found, ferry fares (CNY 20-30 inter-island) are transport not cost; free is unverified. Film attribution from zh Wikipedia (Hou Hui Wu Qi). Draft's sunrise lookout unverified so omitted. Not NT pass; evidence pass-list noise.

hangzhou-35.bio: Paris-style housing estate in Hangzhou, with a 108 m replica of the Eiffel Tower.
hangzhou-35.notes: Free: public streets of a residential estate; no ticket source found, unverified beyond that. 108 m figure from draft, not re-sourced.

east-lake-pinghu.bio: Lakeside park in Pinghu with a waterfront walk and Baoben Temple on its shore.
east-lake-pinghu.ticket_note: municipal park, no official site found
east-lake-pinghu.notes: Free per Ctrip listing (weak, 4A, open-access park). Baoben Temple mention from same listing.

xiandu-scenic-area.bio: National 5A scenic area of peaks, caves and temples, with a cable car and shuttle buses.
xiandu-scenic-area.ticket_note: no official site found (WeChat account only suspected); unverified
xiandu-scenic-area.notes: Price weak: Ctrip from-price 70; 2020 travelogue combined ticket 110 incl. shuttle. Current price unverified. Bio claims from draft, cable car/cave details not re-verified.

quzhou-1.bio: Walled old quarter of Quzhou, built around the Confucian Family Temple of the southern branch.
quzhou-1.notes: UNVERIFIED: Ctrip lists it open all day, centred on Nankong culture; one listing may show ~80 CNY (likely a sub-attraction). Treated as free to wander; Confucian Temple may charge its own entry. Check.

taozhu-ancient-city.bio: Ming-dynasty walled town at Taozhu, built against pirate raids, with its original walls.
taozhu-ancient-city.notes: Ctrip 20 CNY for the ancient city alone (combo with Taojiang 13 Islets 50); another page says 14.5. Weak.

dongsha-ancient-town.bio: Old fishing town on Daishan Island of lanes and courtyard houses.
dongsha-ancient-town.notes: UNVERIFIED: 2022 group-buy price 15 CNY from a ticket reseller; Qunar shows 200 (unclear). Ctrip rates it 4A (paid). Check current price.

hangzhou-39.bio: A large lake park in Xiaoshan with lakeside paths, causeways and boat rides, laid out around the old Xiang Lake.
hangzhou-39.ticket_note: Official site not found or verified; do not guess
hangzhou-39.notes: Entry fee unverified: a weekend guide lists the park as free, an older Bendibao page says 30 CNY, 2022-24 group-buy pages list 15-20 CNY. Boats, sightseeing cars and theme parks are paid extras. Needs the operator's page check; treat free as unverified.

haining-tidal-bore-viewing-park.bio: Riverside park at Yanguan on the Qiantang River, where visitors watch the tidal bore roll upstream along the sea wall.
haining-tidal-bore-viewing-park.ticket_note: Tickets via the Chaole Zhicheng WeChat mini-program; no website found
haining-tidal-bore-viewing-park.notes: Undated guide: off-season 30 CNY, bore-season day ticket 90 CNY; under-18s and over-70s free. Ctrip shows from 30 CNY. Unverified against operator. Bore is best seen on the big-tide days around the 18th of the lunar month.

yangjiatang-village.bio: Quiet hillside village in Songyang county with Qing-dynasty houses and two roughly 500-year-old camphor trees at its entrance.
yangjiatang-village.notes: Free per Ctrip user-compiled page; village ~350 years old with little commercialisation. Not official.

quzhou-2.bio: The southern branch of the Confucius family temple in Quzhou, entered with a ticket bundled with a miniature Analects.
quzhou-2.notes: Price from Ctrip (from 10 CNY); Qunar shows from 7 CNY. Address 96 Xinqiao St, Kecheng.

wu-zixiong-glass-art-museum.bio: Small museum in Jiaojiang showing glass art by Wu Zixiong, his son and his students, on the Jiazhijing cultural corridor.
wu-zixiong-glass-art-museum.notes: 30 CNY from an undated travelogue only; may have changed or be free. Unverified.

gouqi-island.bio: Wolfberry-named island in the Shengsi archipelago with a fishing harbour, painted villages and cliff-top sunrise viewpoints.
gouqi-island.ticket_note: Part of the Shengsi Islands scenic area; no single official site verified
gouqi-island.notes: Island access is free; blogs report a 50 CNY combined ticket (Dawang Beach + East Cliff, one day) while other sights are free. Ferry fares not counted. Unverified; consider costBasis ticket 50 if confirmed.

hangzhou-4.bio: Tea terraces around Longjing village in Hangzhou's hills, where Dragon Well tea is grown and sold.
hangzhou-4.ticket_note: open village with no single steward
hangzhou-4.notes: Free: open residential village, no gate (weak: travel guides/Ctrip). Tea tasting and tea-picking paid extras not counted. Wikipedia article is about the wider Longjing area; confirm wiki title is acceptable.

jiaxing-1.bio: Lake in Jiaxing with a small island and Yanyu Tower, where the Communist Party's first congress ended on a boat in 1921.
jiaxing-1.ticket_note: no official site found; only third-party sources
jiaxing-1.notes: Prices CONFLICT: Ctrip lists the scenic area as free; a ticket site says adult 20 CNY; a travelogue says 55 CNY for Yanyu Tower island. Recorded free (unverified), check on site. Boat to island and memorial hall rules unverified.

danshan-chishui.bio: Canyon and cliff scenic area in Dahan town, Yuyao, in the Siming Mountains, with Taoist cultural sites.
danshan-chishui.ticket_note: no official website found; WeChat/phone only per search
danshan-chishui.notes: Qunar adult from-price 59.9 CNY (rounded to 60); no official price found. Described as 4A scenic area in Shilin village, Dahan town, Yuyao (Qunar). Bio's Taoist/canyon claims from search summary of Qunar/travelogue, unchecked on page.

quzhou-3.bio: Low hill near Quzhou with a natural stone bridge and the cave of the Wang Zhi legend, a cradle of Go lore.
quzhou-3.notes: Free is from a 2020 travelogue (no ticket on a non-holiday weekday) - weak and possibly outdated; current fee unverified. Provincial scenic area, 164 m, danxia rock, stone bridge and Qingxia cave per zh Wikipedia. No English article found.

baizhangji-waterfall.bio: Wencheng waterfall whose first drop of 207 m was recognised in 2013 as China's tallest single drop.
baizhangji-waterfall.ticket_note: official Liu Bowen Hometown scenic area site not found
baizhangji-waterfall.notes: 65 CNY is the Liu Bowen Hometown (national 5A) ticket from an undated Ctrip travelogue, excluding shuttle; Baizhangji is a core section, so it may be a combined ticket. Unverified.

luojia-shan.bio: Small island 5 km east of Putuo Shan with a lighthouse, reached by ferry from Putuo's main pier.
luojia-shan.notes: 70 CNY is a round-trip boat ticket that includes island entry (older travelogue, Ctrip from-price 70). Reaching Putuo Shan needs its own gate fee (140-220 CNY, not counted). Island is partly closed to visitors. Temples/pagoda in draft not verified.

hangzhou-41.bio: Fuyang town where nearly everyone is surnamed Sun, with a Sun clan ancestral hall and old streets to walk.
hangzhou-41.ticket_note: No official site found; Ctrip lists the ancestral hall with fees 'ask the scenic area'.
hangzhou-41.notes: UNVERIFIED price: 70 CNY adult from an undated Ctrip travelogue; Ctrip sight page gives none. Could be free to enter the town. Wikipedia article 'Longmen, Zhejiang' is the whole town, so wiki left null.

jiaxing-4.bio: Canal-side old quarter in Jiaxing, with three parallel streets, teahouses, a flower and bird market and boat rides.
jiaxing-4.ticket_note: Open street district, no single steward site found.
jiaxing-4.notes: Free per Ctrip (weak). Facts (three rivers, three streets, flower and bird market, boat tours) from Ctrip page and search summary.

five-dragon-pool.bio: Ningbo's 4A gorge of five linked pools and waterfalls on a stepped trail, with a glass bridge, in Yinzhou's hills.
five-dragon-pool.ticket_note: No official site found; tel 0574-87893576 on China Daily page.
five-dragon-pool.notes: 50 CNY from 2017 government page; Qunar lists 45. Glass bridge ticket is extra. NAME CLASH: English Wikipedia 'Five Dragon Pool' is Jinan's, so the photo lookup by name would pull the wrong place: needs an override or distinct name (zh label also says Jinan). Coordinates are Ningbo Yinzhou, unchecked by me. Gate fee not a pass.

quzhou-4.bio: Forest park near Quzhou with timber boardwalks, a glass skywalk and a glass slide in the Huangtankou hills.
quzhou-4.notes: Adult 65 CNY from search summary of Ctrip/Qunar (weak; I could not see it on the fetched Qunar page, which shows 79 for skywalk+slide combo). National forest park, AAAA, 15 sq km (China Daily). Skywalk and slide extra. Evidence bundle pass-list was NT Australia, irrelevant.

dasha-ao-beach.bio: Dongtou island's fine iron-sand beach, three-sided by hills, with a cliff cafe and indoor shore-life hall.
dasha-ao-beach.notes: 25 CNY from Wenzhou Daily article (Aug 2026, republished on NetEase), after reopening 31 Jul 2026. Inside Xiandieyan scenic area. Indoor hall may be separately charged.

mount-putuo-1.bio: Mount Putuo's main temple, known as the Front Temple, with a lotus pond, Great Compassion Hall and Guanyin worship.
mount-putuo-1.ticket_note: Mount Putuo scenic area official site not verified.
mount-putuo-1.notes: 5 CNY incense voucher from a Ctrip travelogue (weak, other source omits Puji). Ctrip page shows 245 which is the island's combined ticket with ferry, not Puji's own; the island gate fee is not the spot's price. Name 'Great Compassion Hall' (大圆通殿) is from search summary, verify wording. Needs checking if Puji is actually free.
